heroHeadline: Merch that looks like the band sounds.
heroSubtext: Saucy Fields is a two-person print shop in Winona, MN. We draw, design, and screen-print shirts and posters for local bands — and sell a few of our own along the way.
heroImageAlt: Isaac and Spencer of Saucy Fields

whatWeDo.title: Draw it
whatWeDo.body: Hand-drawn artwork made for your record, your show, or your whole vibe. No clip art, no templates.

whatWeDo.title: Print it
whatWeDo.body: Screen-printed shirts and posters, pulled in small runs so the quality stays high and the box stays light.

whatWeDo.title: Move it
whatWeDo.body: We can run your merch table stock, sell it here on the site, or hand it off at the show. Whatever’s easiest.
